scope: Reconcile primary DXF 3DSOLID fields, ACIS sample-generation boundaries, the pinned LibreDWG AcDs loss report, current peer-source state, and implementation-ready parity controls.

method.kind: Primary documentation/source/issue/PR review and local plan reconciliation
method.evidenceRule: Issue, PR, release, and source observations are bounded by their exact revision and route. Static source presence does not establish successful current runtime behavior. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG layout; Autodesk DXF references remain authoritative for published DXF group fields.

observed: The published 3DSOLID table lists AcDbModelerGeometry, modeler format code 70, proprietary payload text in code 1 with optional continuation lines in code 3, then AcDb3dSolid and soft-owner history handle code 350.
The table does not define the embedded SAT/SAB grammar or DWG AcDs layout.
evidence.planUse: Test subclass ordering, version-gated history handle, group-1/group-3 boundaries, bounded chunk length, and following-entity framing as distinct assertions. Do not treat code 70 as ACIS version or payload validity.

observed: Documentation warns that unsupported ACIS entity types load as NONE_ENTITY and cannot be arbitrarily re-exported losslessly.
Documented SAT 700 and SAB 21800 support follows DXF version bands; body_from_mesh() can create a polyhedral control from a local mesh.
mesh_from_body() returns only flat polygonal faces and loses curved boundaries; ACIS body creation is identified as an external-library task.
evidence.planUse: A locally generated cube can check carrier framing and structural behavior only. It cannot prove curved B-rep support, general ACIS semantics, or independent kernel correctness.

observed: The still-open issue reports that a locally generated AC1032 REGION with a 5,489-byte SAB payload lost its ACDSDATA path when processed by the named LibreDWG build 8a1ae764.
Current master source contains an AcDs section decode function/schema, so the older issue cannot establish that current master has no reader path.
No current master executable was run; static source does not establish that the reproduced payload, owner mappings, DWG writer, or DXF writer now round-trip.
evidence.planUse: Preserve the issue as a pinned failure report and reproducible local-control recipe. Re-test only with exact current source/release pins and separate read, write, and conversion results; otherwise record NOT_RUN.

observed: Issue #1195 remains open; PR #1150 and PR #1240 are also open in the reviewed pages.

PR #1150 contains author-reported versioned DXF/DWG output and TrueView/ODA checks, but the maintainer deferred writer review while the AcDs schema/writer direction is reworked after upstream changes.
PR #1240 is an issue-linked route dependent on the AcDs schema work; neither open PR is a merged-release capability result.
evidence.planUse: Do not use ACadSharp as a currently released ACIS writer oracle. Require exact merged pin, per-entity owner/block disposition, and separately recorded diagnostics if later compared.

observed: The documented DXF 3D extensibility option exposes raw ASMData and a 12-real transform for AC1027+; it does not create OGR solid geometry.
The DWG driver relies on ODA and is not an independent open-source DWG parser route.
evidence.planUse: Keep GDAL at one optional, exact-pinned composed DXF structure/raw-carrier checkpoint, not a semantic solid or open-source DWG vote.

nextActions: At changed local code paths, use a touched strict build and generated fast test; no peer runtime or full-suite run is a prerequisite.
Use separate SAT/code-1+3 controls through AC1024, SAB/ACDSDATA controls from AC1027 onward, and DWG AcDs graph controls; include final-chunk and following-record sentinels.

At one composed checkpoint, pin exact peer commits, replay only locally regenerated controls, and record source handle, owner/block path, payload digest/length, diagnostics, and unsupported disposition.
Require eligible independent analytic-kernel evidence only after entity-to-AcDs/prototype/history and raw SAB closure; a mesh-generated cube remains structural evidence only.
